messages:
alex_acme: Hey support - after our tenant migration this morning our app started getting 403s. We didn't change keys. curl gives 403 with body "entitlement:plan_missing". Anyone seen this?

maya_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact curl + response (no sensitive keys) and the tenant id?

alex_acme: tenant=acme-42
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"entitlement:plan_missing","code":403}

We did a migration from old-tenant-id to acme-42 at 09:12UTC. Keys were copied as-is.

maya_support: Thanks. That response implies the entitlement check is blocking, not an auth token problem. Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm the SSO/OAuth claim is still returning plan scope? 2) any client-side SDK change?

alex_acme: SSO claims look identical, scope includes "redwood:generate". No SDK change. This started immediately after the migration job finished.

tom_sre: @maya_support assigning to eng oncall to validate entitlement sync. @alex_acme can you share the tenant id used in the migration job logs?

alex_acme: migration job shows mapping: old_plan -> null (bug?)

leila_engineer: I pulled the migration job logs for acme-42. There's a corner-case where if the source plan is a custom legacy SKU we accidentally set plan=null in the entitlement table. That can present as an auth-like 403: our gate returns 403 when no active plan is attached.

entitlement_bot: ALERT: entitlement-sync failed for tenant acme-42 at 2034567510 — missing plan mapping. Retry queued.

maya_support: OK, so this is plan/entitlement gating, not invalid API key. Two options: short-term workaround we can attach the fallback plan to your tenant (manual patch), or we escalate an entitlement-sync hotfix. Which do you prefer?

alex_acme: Please do manual patch, we need production back now. Also would like the root fix.

leila_engineer: Working on the hotfix. Patch plan: `UPDATE entitlements SET plan_id='starter' WHERE tenant_id='acme-42' AND plan_id IS NULL;` — will run with audit. Can you confirm no objection to temporary starter plan?

alex_acme: ok to attach starter temporarily. Thanks.

opsbot: Runbook step: applied DB patch to entitlements table for acme-42 by leila_engineer at 2034567920.

maya_support: alex_acme can you re-run the same curl?

alex_acme: re-tested at 2034568001 -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK, tokens generating. Confirmed app back to normal. Thanks everyone :tada:

leila_engineer: Root cause: migration job omitted legacy-plan mapping for certain custom SKUs. We'll ship a one-line fix to the migration transformer and add a validation step to the migration pipeline to assert plan_id != null.

maya_support: Follow-ups: 1) leila to open a PR and release hotfix (ETA 2h). 2) SRE to run audit for other tenants migrated in that window. 3) Support to contact any customers that saw 403s. Tagging opsbot to run tenant audit job.

opsbot: Audit queued: checking tenants migrated between 2034567000 and 2034567600 for null plan_id. Report will follow.

alex_acme: appreciate the quick response. Please keep me posted on the permanent fix.
